name: phil/courses-bundle
description: Online courses in a Symfony application: modules, enrollments, progress and completion, with SCORM and cmi5 packages and an xAPI record store.

suggest.doctrine/orm: For the tables added to the schema the ORM generates
suggest.phil/audit-bundle: To write the second chances asked for, granted, refused and waived to the audit trail
suggest.phil/certificates-bundle: To issue certificates on the completion of a course, answered through its CourseCompletions port
suggest.phil/notifications-bundle: To remind the learners of the courses assigned to them before, on and after their due date, and to tell who assigned them once overdue
suggest.phil/privacy-bundle: To give the SCORM attempts, the cmi5 and xAPI records, the training and the transcripts of a learner in the access and erasure requests
suggest.phil/safe-http: To send the statements to a remote xAPI learning record store
suggest.phil/ux-kit: For the recipes Button, Badge, Progress and Textarea the pages draw, through the Symfony UX Toolkit
suggest.symfony/asset-mapper: To serve the Stimulus controller of the SCORM run time without a build step
suggest.symfony/messenger: For the schedule of the mandatory training, and its handler
suggest.symfony/scheduler: To run the reminders and the recertifications of the mandatory training every day
suggest.symfony/security-core: To name the current learner from the authenticated user, and for the administration page of the second chances
suggest.symfony/security-csrf: For the forms of the pages
suggest.symfony/stimulus-bundle: For the Stimulus controller of the SCORM run time, through AssetMapper
suggest.symfony/twig-bundle: For the pages of the courses
suggest.symfony/ux-twig-component: For the recipes of the kit the pages draw
